title: Grandma's Pot Roast
description: Let's Make My Grandma's Pot Roast

ingredients.item: A whole bag of baby carrots

steps: Place the butter in the crock pot.
Add the chuck roast on top of the butter.
Add the peeled and quartered potatoes.
Add the whole bag of baby carrots.
In a separate bowl, mix the powdered gravy pack into the cold water until well combined.
Pour the gravy mixture over the ingredients in the crock pot.
Cover with the lid and set to cook on low for 8 hours.
After 8 hours, check the pot roast; it should be tender and pull apart easily.
